status: Fixed before computing these new scores; exploratory reuse of previously inspected native data
question: Can a scalar baseline-referenced residual energy summarize steering effects across layers and token positions, without training on steering labels?
scope: CPU only, no model calls, no GPU allocation, no new classifier fit, no automatic monitoring or strength-series execution
references: Original native greedy r4_01-r4_04 BASE only, equal prompt weights. Separate prefill position0 and decode positions1..63 statistics at every one of24 blocks. Prefill has only4 samples, explicitly underidentified.

energies.quadratic: (1/d)*(h-mu)^T*(0.9*Sigma+0.1*tau*I)^-1*(h-mu), population covariance, tau=trace(Sigma)/d; all numerical modes, identity completion through fixed shrinkage
energies.calibration: Divide each layer/phase energy by its BASE TRAIN mean. No labels, TEST calibration, penalty selection, threshold tuning or favorable-direction reversal. These are statistical scores, not proven Lyapunov functions.
energies.global: Uniform mean across all24 calibrated layer energies and first8 prediction positions. Fixed primary. Downstream blocks10..23 and anchor block15 are diagnostics, not replacements. Retain prefill and decode means separately.

evaluation.original_TEST: r4_05-r4_08, native and seeds42/43/44, existing_vector and random_vector, first8 positions only. Four unique prompts; repetitions not independent contexts.
evaluation.older_matched: All6 prompts, base/plus_v/minus_v/random1/random2/norm_only, first8 positions. Three wording pairs, previously inspected OOD panel, no refit.
evaluation.fresh_eight_question_panel: Entirely excluded; keep seven new decode positions geometrically unscored
evaluation.paired: Per prompt E(steered)-E(base), relative change, layer/position profiles. Same forced token IDs required. A paired change supports an intervention effect but is not a single-run detector.
evaluation.single_run: Report absolute BASE and steered scores and descriptive AUROC with HIGH energy fixed as positive. No threshold or deployment claim. Out-of-distribution BASE shifts are a key failure mode.
evaluation.integrity: Verify every consumed native file against EXPORT_HASHES; exact upstream blocks0..9 and token identity. Verify all original and older matched manifest members unchanged after analysis.
evaluation.verification: Quadratic energies nonnegative; SVD inverse agrees with direct solve in a small deterministic planted example; exact symmetric quadratic identity; norm rotation blindness; upstream paired energy exactly0. Report observed-span and outside-span quadratic contributions.

decision: Report all3 candidates and all controls. Do not pick a winning penalty/layer/phase or reverse energy direction. A promising scalar must increase consistently across unique contexts, separate single-run scores from untreated context variation, and pass controls. Reused results cannot establish broad generalization. Recommend a frozen prospective baseline-diversity and signed-strength check only if warranted; do not execute GPU work.
historical_boundaries: Prior semantic/rotation/strong-prefill map failures remain failures. Existing classifier and reserved geometry results unchanged. A global trace aggregate is not evidence of one global potential minimized by the pretrained model.
